description:
City Commute • Weekend Ride • Coastal Cruising
Where classic design meets everyday comfort, the Loiter Beach Cruiser is your all-around ride for life on the go — and at ease. Whether you're commuting through downtown streets, heading out for a laid-back weekend ride, or gliding by the ocean on a sunny afternoon, the Loiter handles it all with style and ease.
Power & Efficiency
The Loiter is powered by an 800W rear-drive motor, delivering an exhilarating riding experience. With a top speed of 25 mph, you can ride longer and enjoy a smoother, more effortless journey.
Conquer Any Terrain with Ease and Adventure
As technology continues to shape our world, staying connected to the simple joys of life is more important than ever. Few experiences match the freedom of riding a bike. The Loiter is built for adventure—whether you're gliding over grass, tackling rugged mountain trails, or cruising through muddy paths with ease. No matter the terrain, Loiter delivers a smooth and effortless ride, bringing you back to the thrill of exploration.
Bright and Reliable for Nighttime Rides
Stay safe and visible with the 48V high-powered headlight, designed to illuminate your path for enhanced night riding. With a strong and focused beam, it ensures clear visibility in low-light conditions, making every ride safer and more confident.
Step-Thru / Step-Over Frame
The Loiter offers two distinct frame designs to match your preference. The Step-Through frame provides easy mounting and dismounting, perfect for effortless rides. Meanwhile, the Step-Over frame delivers a classic, traditional look, ideal for riders who prefer a more structured design. Choose the style that fits you best and ride with confidence.
Details That Matter
Sweat-Resistant Grips
Soft rubber grips that effectively absorb sweat. Designed with ergonomics in mind, its buttons are larger and easier to operate, improving user interaction with the display during rides.
7 Speeds for Any Terrain
Equipped with a Shimano 7-speed gear system, the Loiter offers smooth shifting and easy adaptation to various riding conditions—whether climbing hills, cruising flat roads, or descending slopes.
180mm Disc Brakes
Equipped with 180mm mechanical disc brakes on both front and rear wheels, delivering strong, responsive stopping power for enhanced safety in all riding conditions.
LCD Display
Equipped with a high-contrast LCD display that clearly shows speed, battery level, trip distance, and pedal assist level—giving you full control at a glance.
Oversized Spring Saddle
Features an oversized spring saddle with thick cushioning and built-in shock absorption for enhanced comfort—ideal for long rides.
Quick-Swap Battery
Features an easily removable lithium battery, allowing for convenient indoor charging without moving the entire bike—perfect for everyday commutes or long-distance adventures.
